ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda safe-mode reboot chain to neutralise EDR before encryption
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Qilin (a.k.a. Agenda) pre-encryption sequence where the operator uses bcdedit to force a Safe Mode with networking reboot, registers the ransomware as an auto-start service that survives the reboot, and then forces shutdown — letting the Rust encryptor run with EDR drivers offline. Documented by Trend Micro (Agenda 2023), Sophos X-Ops (Qilin healthcare intrusions 2024) and reported in the Synnovis/NHS incident.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("bcdedit.exe","shutdown.exe","vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","wmic.exe","net.exe","sc.exe") AND (Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*shadows*" OR Processes.process="*-r -f -t*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog*" OR Processes.process="*config* start= auto*" OR Processes.process="*SafeBoot\\Network*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(process_name) as binaries values(cmdline) as commandlines dc(process_name) as distinctBins by dest user | where distinctBins>=2 AND match(mvjoin(binaries,","),"bcdedit") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let lookback = 1d;
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let bcdedit = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("safeboot","SafeBoot")
    | project bcdTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              bcdCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              bcdParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let recoveryKill = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","delete catalog"))
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete catalog")
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
    | project recTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, recCmd = ProcessCommandLine, recBin = FileName;
let rebootForce = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where FileName =~ "shutdown.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-r","/r")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-f","/f","-t 0","/t 0")
    | project shutTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, shutCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
bcdedit
| join kind=inner recoveryKill on DeviceId
| where recTime between (bcdTime - WindowMinutes .. bcdTime + WindowMinutes)
| join kind=inner rebootForce on DeviceId
| where shutTime between (bcdTime .. bcdTime + WindowMinutes)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project bcdTime, DeviceName, AccountName, bcdCmd, recBin, recCmd, shutCmd, bcdParent
| order by bcdTime desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin affiliate credential-access chain: comsvcs.dll MiniDump of LSASS followed by Chrome/Edge Login Data theft
ucs.description: Hunts the Qilin affiliate playbook for harvesting domain-admin and SaaS credentials prior to lateral movement: an LSASS MiniDump produced via rundll32 + comsvcs.dll MiniDump ordinal #24, followed within minutes by the same host opening browser 'Login Data' SQLite files or copying the Local State key. This dual-source credential haul is what affiliates use to pivot into VPN/RDP/RMM (AnyDesk, ScreenConnect) before staging ransomware.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND (Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll*MiniDump*" OR Processes.process="*comsvcs*#24*" OR Processes.process="*MiniDumpWriteDump*" OR Processes.process="*lsass*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name _time span=15m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner dest [| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as fsTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name IN ("Login Data","Login Data For Account","Local State","Cookies","Web Data") OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\User Data\\*\\Login Data*") by Filesystem.dest _time span=15m | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where fsTime>=relative_time(now(),"-1d")] | where fsTime>=firstTime AND fsTime<=firstTime+1800 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
ucs.kql:
let lookback = 1d;
let WindowMin = 30m;
let LsassDump = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where (FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","#24"," 24 "))
         or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDumpWriteDump","OpenProcess","lsass"))
         or (FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)comsvcs.*\s+\d{3,5}\s+[A-Z]:\\")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project dumpTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              dumpCmd = ProcessCommandLine, dumpParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let BrowserCredAccess = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
    | where FileName in~ ("Login Data","Login Data For Account","Local State","Cookies","Web Data")
         or FolderPath has_any (@"\User Data\Default\Login Data", @"\User Data\Default\Local State", @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Default\")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","brave.exe","firefox.exe","opera.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe","MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe","SenseIR.exe","MsMpEng.exe")
    | project credTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, credBin = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              credCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, credPath = FolderPath, credFile = FileName;
LsassDump
| join kind=inner BrowserCredAccess on DeviceId
| where credTime between (dumpTime - 5m .. dumpTime + WindowMin)
| project dumpTime, credTime,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', credTime, dumpTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, dumpCmd, dumpParent,
          credBin, credCmd, credPath, credFile
| order by dumpTime desc

ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin LSASS MiniDump via comsvcs.dll Ordinal 24
id: 4e3c1a32-9b8e-4f4d-9b1f-qilincomsvcs01
status: experimental
description: Detects rundll32 invoking the MiniDump export of comsvcs.dll against LSASS, characteristic of Qilin/Agenda affiliate credential access
author: SOC Detection Engineering
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'comsvcs'
      - 'MiniDump'
  selection_cmd_ord:
    CommandLine|contains: 'comsvcs'
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)\s(#?24|MiniDump)\s+\d{3,5}\s'
  condition: selection_img and (selection_cmd or selection_cmd_ord)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate IT memory-diagnostics with explicit change-ticket
level: high
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.001
  - attack.t1218
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:(4688 OR 1)) @Image:(*\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE) @CommandLine:(*comsvcs* OR *COMSVCS*) @CommandLine:(*MiniDump* OR *minidump* OR *MINIDUMP* OR *#24*)

| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(), min(_time), collect([CommandLine, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName])])
